title: _subscription
description: A subscription of an addon to events, for pub/sub: every subscription whose topic matches an event receives it. Project data: it has no TTL and holds no secret, only the names of the environment variables that configure the addon. Unlike a _brain, nothing is returned to the engine. Draft v0.

topic.description: The changes the addon receives, as {entity}:{operation}, such as _task:update. The topic of an event is its target entity and its operation. The addon filters by itself: it decides which of these events it acts on.

addon.description: Name of the addon that receives the events, such as googlechat. It is the name of a file in src/addons/ of the plugin.

env.description: How the addon is configured: the names the addon expects mapped to the names of environment variables, such as { "webhook": "SUPERTEAM_GCHAT_WEBHOOK" }. Only the names of the variables are stored, never their values, because a value such as the URL of a webhook is a secret and the data is versioned in git.
